intro: OpenAI's newest cyber model found real Chrome zero-days and crossed a new AI capability threshold, while Anthropic quietly flips Claude Code to run autonomously by default starting next week. Dev-tool releases were unusually quiet in the last two days, so that section sits out today. Bitcoin holds near $65K heading into a CPI-heavy week, even as Strategy trims its stack.

items.headline: Anthropic makes Claude Code's auto mode the default
items.summary: Starting August 14, Claude Code will run in auto mode by default for Pro, Max, and Team plans, proceeding without per-step approval unless an action is judged irreversible, destructive, or aimed outside the user's environment.
items.why: Anthropic says a study of 1,053 paid testers found auto mode caught 89% of harmful actions versus 13.6% for manual human review, the case it's making for flipping the default.

items.headline: GitHub Copilot Chat on the web adds minimize, history, and spend tracking
items.summary: GitHub shipped updates to Copilot Chat on github.com: minimizing an in-progress conversation to keep browsing, faster access to recent chats, and per-session and per-message token-spend indicators.

items.headline: OpenAI's new cyber model finds real Chrome zero-days, crosses a safety threshold
items.summary: OpenAI expanded its Daybreak security initiative and launched GPT-5.6-Cyber, which discovered two previously unknown V8 vulnerabilities that could be chained to corrupt memory and escape Chrome's sandbox; Google has patched them as CVE-2026-15903. OpenAI says it's the first model to hit the 'High' cyber capability threshold under its Preparedness Framework.
items.why: OpenAI is making hardware security keys mandatory for all Daybreak accounts by September 1, a sign it sees real offensive risk in a model it's still rolling out.

items.headline: Meta open-sources Muse Glimmer, a 30B model built to run on a single GPU
items.summary: Meta released Muse Glimmer, a distilled, Apache 2.0-licensed 30-billion-parameter version of its Muse Spark model, built for multi-step agentic tasks, coding, and tool use entirely on-device, with or without a network connection.
items.why: Meta's more capable Muse Spark stays closed; Zuckerberg framed Glimmer's release as a bet on distributing capable AI widely rather than centralizing it.

items.headline: Strategy sells 1,690 BTC, raises $653M in a share sale
items.summary: Michael Saylor's Strategy sold 1,690 bitcoin for about $108.6 million at an average price of $64,262, and separately raised $653.1 million selling 6.59 million MSTR shares, using the proceeds for STRC preferred-share buybacks and to grow its cash reserve to $4.65 billion. Holdings fell to 840,447 BTC.

items.headline: Bitcoin and ether ETFs pull in $853M in a week, BlackRock dominant
items.summary: US spot bitcoin and ether ETFs logged their best inflow week since April, drawing roughly $853.5 million over five sessions, with BlackRock's IBIT taking the bulk of it. BlackRock's digital assets head said bitcoin is showing signs of decoupling from equities.

items.headline: Bitcoin holds above $65,000 with US inflation data due this week
items.summary: Bitcoin traded above $65,000, its firmest level in about a week, as traders positioned ahead of upcoming US CPI data that could shape the Fed's next rate move.
